acquirer.name: BlackRock Corporate High Yield Fund VI, Inc.

listed_quote.quote: BlackRock High Yield Trust (NYSE:BHY), BlackRock Corporate High Yield Fund, Inc. (NYSE:COY), BlackRock Corporate High Yield Fund III, Inc. (NYSE:CYE), BlackRock High Income Shares (NYSE:HIS), BlackRock Corporate High Yield Fund V, Inc. (NYSE:HYV) and BlackRock Corporate High Yield Fund VI, Inc. (NYSE:HYT)

announcement.quote: have approved the reorganization of each of BHY, COY, CYE, HIS and HYV into HYT, with HYT continuing as the surviving fund (each, a “Reorganization”).

outcome_evidence.quote: The Fund was a party to a senior committed secured, 360-day rolling credit facility (the “Credit Facility”), which was terminated as of the effective date of the Merger.

deals.notes: Evidence is the fund's own Form N-8F (reason for deregistration: Merger; all assets distributed; shareholder vote 2013-10-11). Shareholders of all six funds approved the reorganizations on 2013-10-11 (accession 0001341004-13-001060. Same press release also covers COY, CYE, HYV and the other of BHY/HIS into HYT; those are not recorded here.
